_readme: Fill in 'date' ONLY when the Department of Examinations has officially
announced the start of that examination, and put the address of the
announcement in 'source'. Never estimate a date from earlier years.
While 'date' is empty the countdown says the date has not been announced
and lets the student enter their own date, which is kept on their device.
date     YYYY-MM-DD, the first day of the examination
source   the official announcement (required when date is set)
After editing this file, run build.cmd.
